raffaele.name: Raffaele Pizzari
raffaele.bio: Raffaele builds OpenTodo in the open: one container, your own server, every feature specified before it is built.
raffaele.note: I started OpenTodo as a replacement for the subscription task apps one household was paying for, and it grew from there. I build it in the open: every feature is written down as a specification before it is built, every release says what changed, and nothing on this site is published without my review. It is not a company and sells nothing. If something is wrong or missing, open an issue; I read every one.
